cost_formula: USD = input_tokens / 1,000,000 * 0.435 + output_tokens / 1,000,000 * 0.87, conservatively using cache-miss input price.
applicability_limit: The configured token-plan endpoint consumes subscription credits rather than normal API balance. This official pay-as-you-go list price is the preregistered reference-cost cap; actual Token Plan credit decrement/billing currency is not exposed and must remain separately reported as unknown.
